description: Specifications: nullable normalized value on typed assignments; value-only edits retain optimistic concurrency; chips display key/value; assignment modal accepts new text and permitted existing suggestions. Add migration, extend ResourceLabels and editor UI. Tests: distinct values per resource, normalization/length, rollback/stale, suggestions read permissions, legacy assignments, chips, modal value editing. Mocking: real Repo and LiveView. Documentation: ingestion and BO guides; shared feature E2E task remains gated. Action reuse: extend existing EditResourceLabels Action with optional value in edits; reuse existing authorization and read Event path for suggestions, no new mutation Action or agent tool. Suggestions are read-only domain projection through confidential Ingestion Event; not a separately exposed agent operation.
title: Support values on document and chunk label assignments
